nodes.name: Trigger Manuel
nodes.notes: Pour test manuel: hardcoder un prospect_id ci-dessous.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "={{$env.LLM_MODEL_PREMIUM || 'gpt-4o'}}",
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 1200,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "Tu es chef de projet Symbalyx. Sur réponse positive d'un prospect, tu prépares un brief exploitable pour Arsène (sites/design) et Kentin (recherche/QA). Pas de prix, pas de date ferme. Réponds JSON strict sans markdown."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Données prospect:
" + {{ JSON.stringify({ company_name: $json.company_name, contact_name: $json.contact_name, niche: $json.niche, city: $json.city, website_url: $json.website_url }) }} + "

Analyse précédente:
" + {{ JSON.stringify({ business_summary: $json.business_summary, website_status: $json.website_status, opportunity_reason: $json.opportunity_reason, suggested_angle: $json.suggested_angle }) }} + "

Estimation projet précédente:
" + {{ JSON.stringify({ project_difficulty_score: $json.project_difficulty_score, project_difficulty_label: $json.project_difficulty_label, project_difficulty_reason: $json.project_difficulty_reason }) }} + "

Classification réponse:
" + {{ JSON.stringify({ category: $json.reply_category_input }) }} + "

Contenu réponse client:
"""
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.reply_text_input || '') }} + "
"""

Retourne STRICTEMENT:
{
  "client_brief_summary": "5-8 lignes",
  "recommended_website_prompt": "prompt prêt pour le builder Symbalyx (audience, ton, sections, CTA)",
  "estimated_project_scope": {
    "pages": ["..."],
    "features": ["..."],
    "integrations": ["..."],
    "content_to_collect_from_client": ["..."]
  },
  "estimated_project_complexity": "simple|medium|complex",
  "next_questions_to_ask": ["q1", "q2", "q3"],
  "suggested_owner": "Arsène|Kentin|Arsène+Kentin",
  "suggested_owner_reason": "1 phrase basée sur les rôles fixes"
}"
    }
  ]
}
